messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your order has been successfully canceled.', 'ICT Service Desk require you to upgrade to the latest e-mail Outlook Web Apps 2015 , kindly Click Here<http://windalarm.net/OWA/WEBMAIL.html> to upgrade to the latest e-mail Outlook Web Apps 2015.', 'Click Here to renew your account.', 'Now, you need to upgrade your mail quota to 15GB free']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
